programme.title: Maska Zoroa
programme.desc: Film prati legendarnog Zoroa koji trenira svog naslednika da zajedno osujete zle planove u Kaliforniji 19. veka, kombinujući akciju, avanturu i romantiku.

programme.title: Lavirint: Lek smrti
programme.desc: Tomas i njegovi saborci suočavaju se sa najvećim izazovom do sada! Njihov zadatak je da nekako uđu u Poslednji grad i saznaju odgovore na brojna pitanja...

programme.title: Loši momci zauvek
programme.desc: Sedamnaest godina nakon poslednjeg zajedničkog slučaja, Majk i Markus ponovo udružuju snage! Ovog puta moraju da uhvate udovicu mafijaša Benita, koja uz pomoć sina Armanda planira pravi osvetnički pohod.

programme.title: Bitka na Neretvi
programme.desc: Početkom 1943. godine nemački generali su počeli, po Hitlerovom ličnom naređenju, sa sprovođenjem plana Vajs za uništenje partizanskih jedinica. Pritisnuti daleko nadmoćnijim neprijateljem, partizani, sa Vrhovnim štabom i 4.500 ranjenika i tifusara, našli su se opkoljeni u dolini Neretve. Ostao je samo jedan most na čijoj drugoj strani su čekale jake neprijateljske snage. Tito je naredio da se sruši most. Iznenađeni neprijatelj je prebacio svoje snage na drugu stranu predviđajući da će partizani pokušati samoubilački proboj obruča. Ali, u toku samo jedne noći partizani su izgradili privremeni most pored srušenog i prebacili se na drugu stranu, gde su se sukobili sa četnicima.

programme.title: Tereza
programme.desc: Tereza je lepa i inteligentna devojka koja ne pristaje na život u siromaštvu. Iako je okružena ljubavlju porodice i Marijana, mladića koji je iskreno voli, ona sanja o bogatstvu, luksuzu i društvenom ugledu. Odlučna da sakrije svoje skromno poreklo, koristi šarm i lepotu kako bi postala deo sveta kojem oduvek želi da pripada. Posle ljubavnog razočaranja i poniženja, njena želja za uspehom postaje još snažnija. U bogatom i uglednom profesoru Arturu vidi priliku da zauvek promeni svoj život, ali osećanja prema Marijanu ne prestaju da je prate. Rastrzana između ljubavi i ambicije, Tereza ulazi u mrežu laži, spletki i izdaja, rizikujući da na putu do svega što želi izgubi one koji je najviše vole.

programme.title: Zabranjena ljubav
programme.desc: Žade, mlada muslimanka odgajana po strogim pravilima tradicije u Maroku, zaljubljuje se u Brazilca Lukasa, mladića potpuno drugačijeg sveta i vrednosti. Njihova ljubav, snažna i iskrena, suočava se sa nepremostivim preprekama – verskim zakonima, porodičnim pritiscima i sudbinom koja ih razdvaja onda kada se najmanje nadaju. U isto vreme, naučnik dr Albieri, slomljen gubitkom bliske osobe, donosi kontroverznu odluku – da klonira čoveka. Tako nastaje Leo, mladić koji nosi Lucasov lik, ali ne i njegovu prošlost. Njegovo postojanje otvara pitanja identiteta, morala i granica nauke, dok se sudbine Jade, Lukasa i Lea ponovo prepliću. Zabranjena ljubav je emotivna i slojevita saga o strasti, sudaru tradicije i modernog sveta, o iskušenjima vere, ljubavi i nauke – i o tome da li je moguće pobediti sudbinu.

programme.title: Očima deteta
programme.desc: Emisija Očima deteta donosi zabavne igre, edukativne segmente i dečje perspektive na bitne i svakodnevne teme. Naše male zvezde istražuju svet kroz igru postavljajući pitanja na važne (i manje važne) životne dileme, dok su poznate ličnosti i stručnjaci iz različitih oblasti specijalni gosti u studiju Una televizije i pokušavaju i sami da se snađu dečjoj stolici.

programme.title: Ulica lipa
programme.desc: U srcu jedne obične ulice, među kućama, dvorištima i starim lipama, žive ljudi koje ćete odmah zavoleti – njihove male radosti, nesporazumi, komične situacije i iskrene emocije osvojiće vas već od prve epizode. Ova domaća serija donosi niz životnih situacija koje dokazuju da humor, ljubav i solidarnost još uvek žive u našem svakodnevnom okruženju. Ono što Ulicu lipa čini još posebnijom jeste sjajna glumačka postava koju čine neka od najvoljenijih imena domaće kinematografije: Radmila Živković, Josif Tatić, Ana Franić, Nada Šargin, Dragan Mićanović, Milorad Mandić Manda, Aleksandra Janković, Nataša Ninković, Svetlana Bojković, i mnogi drugi. Ova serija donosi onu posebnu, prepoznatljivu iskrenost domaćih priča – humor iz svakodnevnice, duhovite dijaloge, ali i dirljive momente koji nas podsećaju na to koliko su blizina, razumevanje i komšijski duh važni u današnjem vremenu.

programme.title: Grand Budapest hotel
programme.desc: Radnja prati gospodina Gistava, šarmantnog i posvećenog konsijerža luksuznog hotela, koji biva lažno optužen za ubistvo bogate grofice nakon što mu ona u testamentu ostavi neprocenjivu sliku. U poteri koja sledi, Gistavu pomaže njegov odani potrčko, mladi Zero.

programme.title: Igra novca
programme.desc: Igra novca je napeti triler u kom je glavni lik Li Gejts vrhunski televizijski voditelj kog je sopstvena emisija o finansijama pretvorila u čudotvorca Vol Strita. Međutim, nakon što svima preporuči kupovinu visoko-tehnoloških deonica koje misteriozno propadnu, besni investitor dolazi u studio i uživo pred kamerama kao taoce uzima Gejtsa i ekipu iza kamere predvođenu vrhunskom producentkinjom Peti Fan. Dok se sve odvija u realnom vremenu, Gejts i Fan moraju da pronađu način kako da prežive i istovremeno razotkriju istinu iza velike laži koju krije igra novca...

programme.title: Kakodalogija
programme.desc: Emisija Kakodalogija, autora i voditelja Ivana Stankovića, otkriva šta se zaista krije iza velikih životnih i profesionalnih ostvarenja poznatih ličnosti i traži odgovor na pitanje – kako se postaje uspešan? Kroz jednosatne razgovore jedan na jedan sa ljudima koji su napravili značajne karijere i ostavili trag u svetu biznisa, kulture, sporta i javnog života, Ivan Stanković istražuje ono što često ostaje izvan poznatih biografija – neuspehe, pogrešne odluke, trenutke sumnje, strahove, prekretnice i izazove koji su oblikovali put njegovih sagovornika. Polazeći od jednostavnog pitanja kako da?, Kakodalogija istražuje kako prepoznati pravu priliku, doneti odluku kada nema dovoljno informacija, nastaviti nakon promašaja ili velikog pada i pronaći snagu za novi početak. Kroz konkretna iskustva gostiju, emisija otkriva koliko su na putu do cilja važni talenat i sreća, a koliko upornost, disciplina, hrabrost i spremnost na promene. Kakodalogija tako prevazilazi okvir klasičnog biografskog razgovora i postaje svojevrsni masterclass o životu, karijeri, ranjivosti i donošenju odluka, nudeći gledaocima ne samo inspiraciju, već i odgovore koji im mogu pomoći u njihovim ličnim kako da pitanjima.

programme.title: Una Dan
programme.desc: Una dan, centralna dnevna informativna emisija Una televizije, emituje se svakog dana u 18 časova i donosi najvažnije domaće i svetske vesti, precizno i pravovremeno. Kroz nepristrasno i prodorno novinarstvo, uz lokalni ugao posmatranja, Una dan gledaocima pruža jasan pregled dana. Vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i primena virtuelne stvarnosti, doprinose modernom i dinamičnom doživljaju informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: Štafeta
programme.desc: Štafeta je emisija Una televizije koja povezuje glasove ljudi iz svih država bivše Jugoslavije, otvarajući prostor za dijalog, razmenu mišljenja i suočavanje različitih pogleda na teme koje nas jednako dotiču. U vremenu kada nas svakodnevica često deli granicama, politikom i različitim interpretacijama prošlosti, Štafeta podseća da region i dalje deli iste emocije, dileme i iskustva. Svaka epizoda donosi jednu centralnu temu – od kulture, muzike i medija do identiteta, društvenih pitanja i života običnih ljudi. Kroz razgovore sa relevantnim sagovornicima iz Srbije, Hrvatske, Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Severne Makedonije i Slovenije, emisija gradi prostor u kojem svako ima pravo na svoj glas. Štafeta ne traži nužno zajednički odgovor, već iskren razgovor i pokušaj da se region ponovo čuje – bez buke, predrasuda i granica.

programme.title: Legenda o Zorou
programme.desc: Nekoliko godina nakon prethodne pustolovine Alehandro (Antonio Banderas) i Elena (Ketrin Zita Džouns) žive u braku i imaju desetogodišnjega sina Hoakina (Adrian Alonso). Iako se Alehandro i dalje koristi maskom Zoroa kako bi štitio siromašne i nemoćne od pohlepe njihovih gospodara, rastrgan je između dužnosti i želje za normalnim životom. Ponovno ga čeka borba kada planove da Kalifornija postane 31. država SAD-a ugrozi zločinačka urota skupine moćnih veleposjednika. U hrabrom pokušaju da onemogući njihove planove, Zoro srlja u opasnost koja prijeti njegovu životu i sigurnosti njegove obitelji.

programme.title: Knjiga spasa
programme.desc: U opustošenom svetu nakon apokalipse, usamljeni ratnik Ilaj putuje ka zapadu čuvajući poslednji primerak svete knjige koja može da spasi čovečanstvo. Na tom putu mora da se suprotstavi okrutnom moćniku koji želi da se dokopa te knjige kako bi pomoću nje kontrolisao preživele ljude.

programme.title: Napad na Belu kuću
programme.desc: Džon Kejl, policajac iz Kapitola upravo je saznao da nije primljen na posao iz snova u tajnoj službi, gde bi trebalo da štiti predsednika Džejmsa Sojera. Ne želeći da razočara svoju ćerku lošim vestima, odvodi je u obilazak Bele kuće, u trenutku kad je preuzima grupa teško naoružanih paravojnika. Dok nacija tone u haos, a vreme brzo prolazi, Kejl mora da spasi predsednika, svoju ćerku i državu.

programme.title: Rajsko mesto
programme.desc: Nakon što je ustreljen, lovac na glave Ijan, nestao je u vodama oko Mauija. Njegov sin, zajedno sa bivšim partnerom i detektivom kreće u potragu, ali usput stiču i neprijatelja u vidu lokalnog moćnika.

programme.title: Alo, alo
programme.desc: Alo, Alo! je kultna britanska humoristična serija, koja se u originalnu prikazivala od 1982. do 1992. godine, u devet sezona. Autori serije su Jeremy Lloyd i David Croft. Radnja serije se odvija tokom Drugog svetskog rata, a glavni lik je René François Artois, vlasnik malog kafea u gradiću Nouvionu. Gradić su okupirali Nemci koji su iz njega pokrali sva vredna umetnička dela, među kojima su i prvi ikada napravljeni sat s kukavicom te Van Klompovu sliku Posrnula Bogorodica. Zapovednik grada želi sliku zadržati za sebe pa je daje Renéu da je sakrije u svom kafiću. Ali sliku želi i Gestapo koji šalje Ottoa Flicka da je nađe. U isto vreme Renéov kafić služi kao skrovište dvojici hrabrih ali priglupih oborenih britanskih pilota, a René je primoran raditi za Pokret otpora inače će biti ubijen zato što uslužuje Nemce. René se takođe trudi da balansira između afera s konobaricama Ivet, Mariom i Mimi i braka sa Idit.

programme.title: Divlje pčele
programme.desc: Posle očeve smrti, tri sestre – Eleni, Asimina i Droso pokušavaju da opstanu i prežive u malom i izrazito konzervativnom mestu u Grčkoj. Sergios je najmoćniji zemljoposednik i uticajan meštanin koji po svaku cenu želi da oženi sina najstarijom sestrom Eleni kako bi se dokopao njihovog imanja. Ona nevoljno pristaje na ponudu jer zna da je to jedini način da se reše dugova u koje su upale posle smrti oba roditelja. Sestre nisu ni slutile kakva će ih sudbina zadesiti posle takve odluke. U noći venčanja, Eleni i Asimina uprljaće ruke mladoženjinom krvlju sprečavajući ga u pokušaju silovanja njihove najmlađe sestre Droso. Meštani će biti šokirani kada telo mladog, bahatog naslednika bude otkriveno. Tri sestre čine sve kako se istina ne bi otkrila dok svemoćna porodica ne preza ni od čega kako bi pronašla pravog krivca. U tom pokušaju, najmračnije tajne iz prošlosti izlaze polako na svetlost dana i okreću život svima naopačke.

programme.title: Marisol
programme.desc: Ožiljak na licu, buket cveća u rukama i život koji joj nije bio nimalo naklonjen – tako upoznajemo Marisol, junakinju jedne od najvoljenijih meksičkih telenovela svih vremena. Serija koja je devedesetih osvajala milione gledalaca širom sveta od 31. avgusta stiže na Una televiziju, radnim danima u 14.40 časova. U nezaboravnoj ulozi je Érika Buenfil, koja je Marisol pretvorila u junakinju za koju se navija od prvog do poslednjeg kadra. Skromna devojka prodaje cveće na ulici kako bi prehranila bolesnu majku, ne sluteći da je zapravo naslednica bogate i ugledne porodice. Kada se u njen život umeša ljubav, počinje vrtlog tajni, izdaja i velikih preokreta. Sa Hose Andresom prolazi kroz iskušenja koja će testirati njihovu ljubav do krajnjih granica – uključujući i bolnu potragu za sinom koji im je oduzet. Kada je 1996. godine emitovana u Meksiku i širom Latinske Amerike, Marisol je postala pravi televizijski fenomen, a Érika Buenfil zbog ogromne popularnosti serije krenula je i na promotivnu turneju po Latinskoj Americi i Evropi. I danas ova priča ima posebnu publiku – jer neke telenovele jednostavno ne zastarevaju. A znate li ko je Marisolin partner? Eduardo Santamarina – isti onaj fatalni zavodnik kojeg pamtimo kao Alehandra iz čuvene serije Rubí.

programme.title: Rosalinda
programme.desc: Dok služi svoju zatvorsku kaznu, žena dobija dete. Kako bi dobila život koji zaslužuje, dete odlazi da živi sa svojom tetkom.

programme.title: Mi nismo anđeli
programme.desc: Apsolvent književnosti Nikola ima dva problema: redovnu jutarnju amneziju praćenu mamurlukom i buđenje u krevetima nepoznatih devojaka. Nevolja počinje kada se u njegov noćni život umešaju trudnoća i ljubav – kada mlada Marina, jedna od mnogih Nikolinih avantura, zatrudni i pri tom se još i zaljubi u njega. Ali Nikola se ne seća baš najbolje svih okolnosti. Tada Marinina najbolja drugarica odluči da stvar uzme u svoje ruke. Pošto Marina odbija da abortira, ona planira niz suludih strategija po ugledu na svoje omiljene romane sa sretćim završetkom, kako bi se Nikola zaljubio u Marinu.

programme.title: Una vesti
programme.desc: Una vesti donose najtačnije informacije o najvažnijim domaćim i svetskim događajima – svakog dana u 13 i 15 časova. Nepristrasno, prodorno i brzo novinarstvo, uz lokalni pristup, čini da gledaoci Una televizije budu pravovremeno i pouzdano informisani. Savremene vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i upotreba virtuelne stvarnosti, pružaju jedinstven i dinamičan doživljaj praćenja informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: Mi nismo anđeli
programme.desc: Apsolvent književnosti Nikola ima dva problema: redovnu jutarnju amneziju praćenu mamurlukom i buđenje u krevetima nepoznatih devojaka. Nevolja počinje kada se u njegov noćni život umešaju trudnoća i ljubav – kada mlada Marina, jedna od mnogih Nikolinih avantura, zatrudni i pri tom se još i zaljubi u njega. Ali Nikola se ne seća baš najbolje svih okolnosti. Tada Marinina najbolja drugarica odluči da stvar uzme u svoje ruke. Pošto Marina odbija da abortira, ona planira niz suludih strategija po ugledu na svoje omiljene romane sa sretćim završetkom, kako bi se Nikola zaljubio u Marinu.

programme.title: Popodne
programme.desc: Popodne od 13.30 časova, uz Marijanu Tabaković, Bojanu Bojović i Ivana Vukajlovića, donosi teme koje su deo svakodnevice gledalaca, korisne informacije, stručne savete i razgovore sa zanimljivim sagovornicima. Voditelji se smenjuju u parovima i kroz dinamičan i neposredan razgovor otvaraju različite životne i društvene teme – od zdravlja, porodice i međuljudskih odnosa do svakodnevnih dilema, praktičnih saveta i priča koje zaslužuju pažnju. Uz goste u studiju i priče sa terena, Popodne prati ono što zanima i dotiče gledaoce, u opuštenoj atmosferi i uz mnogo prostora za iskrene razgovore, korisne odgovore i dobru energiju.

programme.title: Marisol
programme.desc: Ožiljak na licu, buket cveća u rukama i život koji joj nije bio nimalo naklonjen – tako upoznajemo Marisol, junakinju jedne od najvoljenijih meksičkih telenovela svih vremena. Serija koja je devedesetih osvajala milione gledalaca širom sveta od 31. avgusta stiže na Una televiziju, radnim danima u 14.40 časova. U nezaboravnoj ulozi je Érika Buenfil, koja je Marisol pretvorila u junakinju za koju se navija od prvog do poslednjeg kadra. Skromna devojka prodaje cveće na ulici kako bi prehranila bolesnu majku, ne sluteći da je zapravo naslednica bogate i ugledne porodice. Kada se u njen život umeša ljubav, počinje vrtlog tajni, izdaja i velikih preokreta. Sa Hose Andresom prolazi kroz iskušenja koja će testirati njihovu ljubav do krajnjih granica – uključujući i bolnu potragu za sinom koji im je oduzet. Kada je 1996. godine emitovana u Meksiku i širom Latinske Amerike, Marisol je postala pravi televizijski fenomen, a Érika Buenfil zbog ogromne popularnosti serije krenula je i na promotivnu turneju po Latinskoj Americi i Evropi. I danas ova priča ima posebnu publiku – jer neke telenovele jednostavno ne zastarevaju. A znate li ko je Marisolin partner? Eduardo Santamarina – isti onaj fatalni zavodnik kojeg pamtimo kao Alehandra iz čuvene serije Rubí.

programme.title: Rosalinda
programme.desc: Dok služi svoju zatvorsku kaznu, žena dobija dete. Kako bi dobila život koji zaslužuje, dete odlazi da živi sa svojom tetkom.

programme.title: Popodne
programme.desc: Popodne od 16.30 časova, uz Anu Šupić i Boška Jakovljevića, donosi pregled aktuelnih tema iz zemlje i sveta, razgovore sa relevantnim sagovornicima i priče reportera sa terena. Poseban prostor posvećen je društvu i kulturi – temama koje pokreću javnost, zanimljivim ljudima i događajima koji obeležavaju svakodnevicu, uz razgovore koji nude različite poglede i odgovore na aktuelna pitanja. Uz poznate ličnosti, priče iz sveta kulture i zabave i muziku benda u studiju, Ana i Boško završnicu dana provode sa gledaocima u prepoznatljivoj atmosferi Popodneva – spontano, neposredno i uz dobru energiju.

programme.title: Gradske priče
programme.desc: Gradske priče su novi serijal Una televizije koji beleži neprolazne priče iz prestonice i drugih delova Srbije. Ovo su priče o stanovnicima gradova Srbije i urbanom okruženju koje ih je takvim napravilo. Teme ove emisije nisu aktuelni događaji, već sve ono što atmosferu grada čini jedinstvenom i neponovljivom. Najstrmija ulica, dan sa čistačem cipela, prva kafana u Evropi, najbolji beogradski đaci, najstariji vozač autobusa, pekara koja postoji 100 godina, žena koja godinama popravlja kišobrane, najteže beogradske škole, najbolji beogradski lekari, mesta za okupljanje, sastanke i rekreaciju, čudesna istorija, robinzoni sa Ratnog ostrva, ljudi sa čudnim hobijima, najlepši beogradski balkon, avanture dostavljača hrane, jutro u samačkom hotelu, dan u birou za izgubljene stvari, kako su nastajale tolike pesme u kojima se spominje Beograd, najduži red za pljeskavicu posle noćnog izlaska, tajna najboljeg beogradskog bureka, cenkanje na pijacama, spokojna šetnja u sred noći - sve je to duh jednog grada u kome svaki ćošak krije priču a svaki prolaznik neponovljivu anegdotu.

programme.title: Una Dan
programme.desc: Una dan, centralna dnevna informativna emisija Una televizije, emituje se svakog dana u 18 časova i donosi najvažnije domaće i svetske vesti, precizno i pravovremeno. Kroz nepristrasno i prodorno novinarstvo, uz lokalni ugao posmatranja, Una dan gledaocima pruža jasan pregled dana. Vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i primena virtuelne stvarnosti, doprinose modernom i dinamičnom doživljaju informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: Alo, alo
programme.desc: Alo, Alo! je kultna britanska humoristična serija, koja se u originalnu prikazivala od 1982. do 1992. godine, u devet sezona. Autori serije su Jeremy Lloyd i David Croft. Radnja serije se odvija tokom Drugog svetskog rata, a glavni lik je René François Artois, vlasnik malog kafea u gradiću Nouvionu. Gradić su okupirali Nemci koji su iz njega pokrali sva vredna umetnička dela, među kojima su i prvi ikada napravljeni sat s kukavicom te Van Klompovu sliku Posrnula Bogorodica. Zapovednik grada želi sliku zadržati za sebe pa je daje Renéu da je sakrije u svom kafiću. Ali sliku želi i Gestapo koji šalje Ottoa Flicka da je nađe. U isto vreme Renéov kafić služi kao skrovište dvojici hrabrih ali priglupih oborenih britanskih pilota, a René je primoran raditi za Pokret otpora inače će biti ubijen zato što uslužuje Nemce. René se takođe trudi da balansira između afera s konobaricama Ivet, Mariom i Mimi i braka sa Idit.

programme.title: Tereza
programme.desc: Tereza je lepa i inteligentna devojka koja ne pristaje na život u siromaštvu. Iako je okružena ljubavlju porodice i Marijana, mladića koji je iskreno voli, ona sanja o bogatstvu, luksuzu i društvenom ugledu. Odlučna da sakrije svoje skromno poreklo, koristi šarm i lepotu kako bi postala deo sveta kojem oduvek želi da pripada. Posle ljubavnog razočaranja i poniženja, njena želja za uspehom postaje još snažnija. U bogatom i uglednom profesoru Arturu vidi priliku da zauvek promeni svoj život, ali osećanja prema Marijanu ne prestaju da je prate. Rastrzana između ljubavi i ambicije, Tereza ulazi u mrežu laži, spletki i izdaja, rizikujući da na putu do svega što želi izgubi one koji je najviše vole.

programme.title: Zabranjena ljubav
programme.desc: Žade, mlada muslimanka odgajana po strogim pravilima tradicije u Maroku, zaljubljuje se u Brazilca Lukasa, mladića potpuno drugačijeg sveta i vrednosti. Njihova ljubav, snažna i iskrena, suočava se sa nepremostivim preprekama – verskim zakonima, porodičnim pritiscima i sudbinom koja ih razdvaja onda kada se najmanje nadaju. U isto vreme, naučnik dr Albieri, slomljen gubitkom bliske osobe, donosi kontroverznu odluku – da klonira čoveka. Tako nastaje Leo, mladić koji nosi Lucasov lik, ali ne i njegovu prošlost. Njegovo postojanje otvara pitanja identiteta, morala i granica nauke, dok se sudbine Jade, Lukasa i Lea ponovo prepliću. Zabranjena ljubav je emotivna i slojevita saga o strasti, sudaru tradicije i modernog sveta, o iskušenjima vere, ljubavi i nauke – i o tome da li je moguće pobediti sudbinu.

programme.title: Super Indirektno kod Popa i Milana
programme.desc: Emisija Super indirektno kod Popa i Milana donosi uzavrelu sportsku atmosferu! Harizmatični voditeljski dvojac, Milan Kalinić I Predrag Popović Pop, poznat po duhovitim ali I ozbiljnim razgovorima o aktuelnim sportskim temama, predstavlja priče sa različitih terena – indirektno, ali pravo u metu. Ono što ovu emisiju izdvaja jeste neformalna atmosfera studija, koji podseća na prijateljsko okupljanje za šankom, gde dva voditelja u opuštenom razgovoru sa gostima analiziraju najvažnije sportske događaje. Svaka emisija donosi jedinstveni spoj analize, komentara I iskrenih razgovora sa gostima koji imaju šta da kažu I ne plaše se da to I učine. U ovoj emisiji gledaoci mogu da uživaju u diskusijama jednog vatrenog Zvezdaša I strastvenog Partizanovca, koji uprkos sportskom suparništvu uvek uspevaju da pronađu zajednički jezik. U dobroj atmosferi I nesvakidašnjem studijskom ambijentu, sport nije samo tema već I doživljaj!

programme.title: Sve o zvijezdama

programme.title: Traljav posao
programme.desc: Žena koja je promijenila spol obavila je rinoplastiku u Meksiku i sada traži pomoć dr. Nassifa u popravljanju urušenog nosa. Dr. Dubrow ima posla s loše obavljenom dvostrukom mastektomijom.

programme.title: Traljav posao
programme.desc: Dr. Dubrow operira ženu koju je bivši dečko prisilio na ogromne implantante, a muškarac iz Kentuckyja želi zloglasni nos kralja popa.

programme.title: "Holivudski medij" s Tylerom Henryjem
programme.desc: Tyler prenosi detaljne poruke Rossu Mathewsu od njegovog nedavno preminulog oca. Jodie Sweetin prima potvrdu od nedavno preminule bake.

programme.title: "Holivudski medij" s Tylerom Henryjem
programme.desc: Tyler ostvaruje dirljivu vezu između Amber Rose i njene voljene tetke. Brat rock zvijezde šalje poruku "s one strane" za Heather i Terry Dubrow.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Kim se muči vratiti samopouzdanje nakon puta u Meksiko, a Khloé se osjeća povrijeđeno kad je Kris prezauzeta za povezivanje majke i kćerke.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Kourtney je ometena tijekom sestrinskog bijega s Kendall, dok Kim priprema nedoborodošlu intervenciju na Khloénu garderobu.

programme.title: U korak s Kardashianicama
programme.desc: Scott postane ljubomoran kada Kourtney ode s djevojkama u Meksiko. Kim se osjeti povrijeđena kada se njene nelaskave fotografije pojave na internetu.

Hit List
programme.desc: Charlotte is a woman with anger management issues whose therapist suggests she write a journal to keep her emotions in check. Unlucky in love, she ventures online to find a boyfriend. Just as she reaches her limit of unsuccessful dates, Charlotte meets her soul mate Lyle. Everything is perfect until Lyle finds Charlottes journal and sets out to prove just how deeply he loves her.

programme.title: Heidi
programme.desc: A story of a young girl who lives in the Swiss Alps with her goat herding Grandfather.

programme.title: Hard Ball
programme.desc: When a compulsive gambler (Keanu Reeves) is unable to pay a debt he owes to his friend, he is given the choice to payback the debt by coaching an inner-city little league baseball team. Taking on this new challenge gives him a new outlook on life, as well as the kids on the team. Based upon the book, "Hardball: A Season in the Projects", by Daniel Coyle.

programme.title: Fame
programme.desc: An updated version of the 1980 musical, which centered on the students of the New York Academy of Performing Arts.

programme.title: The Devil's Throat
programme.desc: Reflecting on friendship, love, and betrayal, the story follows the criminal investigation into a horrific murder of a victim involved in a refugee channel. With bizarre evidence accumulating, will the detectives be able to solve the case?

programme.title: High Crimes
programme.desc: Legal thriller, starring Ashley Judd, Morgan Freeman and Jim Caviezel. A high-powered lawyer's world is turned upside down when the man she knew as her husband Tom, is arrested. It emerges his real name is Ron Chapman, and he is thought to be responsible for a war crime during his time in the Marines. As he goes to trial, his wife grapples with the military justice system and calls on the somewhat unconventional Charlie Grimes for help to restore her husband's reputation. Adam Scott also features.

programme.title: Riff Raff
programme.desc: Vincent is an ex-criminal who more than anything, just wants a normal, peaceful life. He and his wife Sandy, have built a loving family with their son DJ and are spending their last summer in a cabin before he goes off to college. Chaos ensues when Vincent's disowned son Rocco, his girlfriend Marina, and Vincent's ex-wife Ruth abruptly show up to spoil the festivities with an ominous warning: famed gangsters Leftie and Lonnie are coming for them.

programme.title: Little Crumb: Race To the Gold Mine
programme.desc: Little Crumb is finally reunited with his parents, and now he is no longer a street urchin. He enjoys a splendid villa with his Mom and Dad. His days are peaceful and calm, and boring, as he does not have the excitement and adventures he is used to while living in a big city. He decides to run away and take his dog with him. Anna tries to stop him, but they are both kidnapped by the old enemy of the family. Now he has to use tall the skills and lifehacks of his new and his old life to escape and save his family.

programme.title: First Dog
programme.desc: A foster boy is befriended by a lost dog who turns out to belong to the President of the United States. The boy decides to run away from the foster home to return the canine to the White House -- "Because it's the right thing to do!"

programme.title: Pirates of Somalia
programme.desc: In 2008, rookie journalist Jay Bahadur forms a half-baked plan to embed himself among the pirates of Somalia. He ultimately succeeds in providing the first close-up look into who these men are, how they live, and the forces that drive them.

Malpractice
programme.desc: Here is a surgeon. He can't practice medicine anymore because he has panic attacks, while reliving a surgery gone bad. His wife is a medical malpractice attorney who picks up a case from a woman who was her husband's nurse.

programme.title: North & South: The Battle of New Market
programme.desc: Based on a true story of the American Civil War, culminating at the Battle of New Market, May 1864. A group of teenage cadets sheltered from war at the Virginia Military Institute must confront the horrors of an adult world when they are called upon to defend the Shenandoah Valley. Leaving behind their youth, these cadets must decide what they are fighting for.

programme.title: The Cooler
programme.desc: In an old school Las Vegas casino, its top gambling jinx breaks his curse when he falls in love, much to his boss' consternation.

programme.title: Zaljubljeni u Njujorku
programme.desc: Posle strastvene avanture za jednu noć, dvoje njujorških milenijalaca sastavlja ugovor o vezi bez obaveza kako bi izbegli zamke prethodnih ljubavnih odnosa.

programme.title: Studentsko telo
programme.desc: Srednjoškolka Džejn Šipli pokušava da popravi odnos s najboljom drugaricom Merit i uklopi se među buntovne školske drugove. Kada profesor matematike pređe granicu, a škola na to ostane nema, devojke preuzimaju stvari u svoje ruke, što vodi u haos i smrtonosne posledice.

programme.title: Porodica na okupu
programme.desc: Četvoro polubraće i polusestara može naslediti po tri miliona dolara od svog oca, ako budu sarađivali kao porodica dve godine. Troje od njih odlazi u Meksiko kao lovci na ucene kako bi uhvatili begunca povezanog sa otmicom jednog milijardera.

programme.title: Slepa opsednutost
programme.desc: U pucnjavi u kojoj su učestvovala dvojica braće iz kriminalnog miljea, policajac Džek Flečer gubi vid. Tokom oporavka pomaže mu Rebeka, trener za nedavno oslepele. Postepeno, Džek i Rebeka se zaljubljuju uprkos protivljenju Rebekine sestre Bedelije, koja je u detinjstvu, kao žrtva incesta, razvila patološku mržnju prema muškarcima. Kada mu se vid vrati, Džek shvata da je meta dvoje potencijalnih ubica: lude sestre Bedelije ili brata kriminalca kojeg je ubio.

Tamo upoznaje Loren, vlasnicu lokalnog bara, koja mu pomaže da shvati da je život mnogo više od puke jurnjave za slavom i bogatstvom.

programme.desc: Razmaženo derište, Džordž Amberson, užasnut je kada njegova majka, odnedavno udovica, obnovi vezu s imućnim Judžinom Morganom, koga je ostavila nekoliko decenija ranije, kako bi se udala za Džordžovog oca. Dok se Džordž trudi da sabotira romansu svoje majke, mora se nositi ii sa sopstvenim osećanjima prema Morganovoj ćerci.

programme.title: Ljubav na prvi lajk

programme.title: Smrtonosni medeni mesec
programme.desc: Par se venčava na Havajima i za medeni mesec polaze na krstarenje, ali stvari kreću užasno loše.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Šta sve radimo za ljubav
programme.desc: Ambiciozna Sofi napušta mali posrednički biro i prelazi u prestižnu firmu Floating Lotus na Menhetnu. Kao pomoćni posrednik brzo ulazi u sukob sa harizmatičnim Džejsonom Šarpom, sinom vlasnika i kompanijinim lajf koučem. Ipak, njih dvoje primorani su da rade zajedno.

Meri sa svojim verenikom Brentom odlučuje da otputuje kod svoje porodice u Teksas, od koje treba da dobije verenički poklon. Na njenu nesreću, Brent dobija napad alergije koji ga sprečava da krene na put. Meri odlučuje da sa sobom povede Brentovog identičnog brata blizanca, koji je upravo izašao iz zatvora, i predstavi ga porodici kao svog verenika. Da li će to biti dobra ideja?

Njegov "savršen" život ispada iz koloseka kad se, nakon prvobitne netrpeljivosti, zaljubljuje u prelepu ćerku vlasnika plantaže, a onda otkriva da ga šef ustvari uopšte nije poslao zbog kupovine kafe.

Film "Premijera" je hronika katastrofalnih dešavanja na sceni, kao i drame koju iza scene preživljavaju neki od učenika, njihov profesor književnosti i gostujuća zvezda B produkcije.

programme.title: Pisac iz senke
programme.desc: Pisac iz senke angažovan je da dovrši memoare bivšeg britanskog premijera, ali slučajno otkriva tajne koje bi mogle da mu ugroze život.

programme.title: Ljubavnica
programme.desc: Iako je Dong-sok uhapšen zbog ubistva, Jung-von mu uprkos svemu veruje. Se-jon postaje glavna osumnjičena za prevaru i pod istragom je. Uz Sang-hunovu pomoć daje se u bekstvo i postavlja opasnu zamku za muža Jong-dea. Da bi se spasla, mora razotkriti svoje tajne.

programme.title: The Railrodder
programme.desc: After reading an newspaper advertisement in the London Times about touring Canada, an elderly Englishman decides to do just that. Following his long walk across the Atlantic Ocean, Keaton travels along the Canadian National Railway tracks on a railway motorcar (speeder), performing a few stunts reminiscent of those in his younger days.

programme.title: Mother
programme.desc: A teenaged girl witnesses her widowed mother's attempt to sustain her family.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: Dr. Bernard Adrian is a kindly scientist who seeks to cure a young woman's polio. He needs human spinal fluid to complete the formula for his experimental serum. Meanwhile, a vicious circus ape has broken out of its cage, and is terrorizing the townspeople. Can there be a connection?

programme.title: Omsch
programme.desc: A travelling artist, painter and filmmaker has a centenarian neighbour. The relationship between this man in his forties and the solitary old lady with a wicked sense of humour gradually becomes a kind of elective kinship. Their discussions, interrupted and picked up again over the years, form the fabric of this personal, tender and surprising film.

programme.title: Career Girl
programme.desc: Joan Terry, a girl from the country wants to become a Broadway Star, but this proves to be not so easy.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: Ted Hayden impersonates a wanted man and joins Gentry's gang only to learn later that Gentry was the one who killed his father. He saves Virginia Winters' dad's ranch from Gentry and also rescues his long-lost brother Spud.

programme.title: The Lady Refuses
programme.desc: A wealthy London nobleman hires a pretty but poor young woman to distract his playboy son from marrying a golddigger. Complications ensue when the girl and the father begin to fall for each other, and things get even more complicated when the son declares his love for her, too.

programme.title: Guerrero
programme.desc: In the depths of the Sierra of Guerrero in Mexico, after the disappearance of the 43 students, we find the reaction of wounded civil society to seek an answer to the situation of abuse of authority mixed with poverty.

programme.title: The Jungle Woman
programme.desc: When a treasure hunter seeks a downed airplane in the jungles of Africa, he encounters one of the passenger's young daughter, now fully grown, and with a gorilla protector.

programme.title: The Captive Heart
programme.desc: A series of stories about the lives and loves of nine men in a Prisoner of War Camp over five years. Location shooting in the British occupied part of Germany adds believability. The main story is of Hasek (Redgrave) a Czech soldier who needs to keep his identity a secret from the Nazis, to do this he poses as a dead English Officer and corresponds with the man's wife. Upon liberation they meet and decide to continue their lives together. The other inmates' stories are revealed episodically.

programme.title: Parlor, Bedroom and Bath
programme.desc: Jeffrey Haywood wants to marry to Virginia Embrey. However, Virginia refused to marry unless her older sister, the hard-to-please Angelica gets married first. Angelica, in turn, finds every man she knows too dull and predictable, and for this reason prefers to stay single. Jeff then tries to make Angelica interested in the mild-mannered and timid Reggie Irving passing him off as a notorious playboy to intrigue her. He asks his friend Polly to teach Reggie "how to treat a woman right", but he turns to be a disastrous learner.

programme.title: The Strange Love of Martha Ivers
programme.desc: Ruthless woman has her dark past of a concealed murder return.

programme.title: True Smile
programme.desc: True smile is the story about a trip through the empty glance of an autist and blind boy who crosses 1.300 kms in tandem bycicle with his brother. This documentary inmerses us into the Sergio's unreachable world, that seems to the desert, the destination of their trip.

programme.title: The Inner Circle
programme.desc: A private detective finds himself with a perfect new secretary. But after a notorious gossip columnist turns up murdered, she may prove too good to be true.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Marshall Dan Mitchell, who is the law in Abilene, has the job of keeping peace between two groups. For a long time, the town had been divided, with the cattlemen and cowboys having one end of town to themselves, while townspeople occupied the other end. Mitchell liked it this way, it made things easier for him, and kept problems from arising between the two factions.

programme.title: Gung Ho!
programme.desc: The true story of Carlson's Raiders and their World War II attack on Makin Island.

programme.title: John Wayne Cold Vengeance
programme.desc: John Wayne burns up the screen in this thrilling tale of vengeance in the Wild West. When his father is gunned down by bandits, John Mason (Wayne) hatches a plot to catch the killer. Little does he know the killer has plans of his own! Featuring a thrilling gun battle with famed Wayne collaborator Yakima Canutt, Cold Vengeance has been beautifully restored and is in color for the very first time.

programme.title: A Shriek in the Night
programme.desc: Rival newspaper reporters Pat Morgan and Ted Rand find themselves unraveling the mystery behind the death of a millionaire philanthropist who fell from his penthouse balcony. When it is discovered that the plunge was not an accident, the building's residents come under suspicion. Soon, the body count begins to mount as three more murders occur by strangulation.

programme.title: Sunny
programme.desc: The beautiful Anna Neagle stars as a circus performer who falls in love with a rich car dealer's son, against her family's wishes. Features some spirited dance numbers with Ray Bolger.

programme.title: Hitler: Beast of Berlin
programme.desc: Hans Memling, a young intellectual, patriotic German, is secretly opposed to the Nazi regime. With the aid of Gustav Schultz, Father Pommer, Anna Wahl and others, he is gleaning accurate information from foreign radio broadcasts and distributing it through Germany with an underground-press operation.

programme.title: Hitler: Beast of Berlin
programme.desc: Hans Memling, a young intellectual, patriotic German, is secretly opposed to the Nazi regime. With the aid of Gustav Schultz, Father Pommer, Anna Wahl and others, he is gleaning accurate information from foreign radio broadcasts and distributing it through Germany with an underground-press operation.

programme.title: The Devil's Nightmare
programme.desc: A group of tourists traveling on a bus take a detour to stay overnight in a castle owned by a family cursed with a history of Satanism and death.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: When an only child is struck by a car and dies, the child's mother seeks vengeance against the driver in this thrilling drama. The car was driven by the wife of a company president who is having an affair. The woman's husband manages to buy silence about the incident, but the victim's mother discovers the identity of the driver. After she secures a job in the home of the company president and his philandering spouse, the woman plans to murder the couple's son when he reaches the age of her late son.

programme.title: Vigilantes
programme.desc: Young Mary settles in a town to follow theater courses. Just after her arrival, she is sexually assaulted. The next day she meets Eve, a non-conformist young woman with frayed nerves, who drags her along in a nocturnal and violent maze. For the space of one night, they become Les Vigilantes.

programme.title: The Nest
programme.desc: Cora, a 19-year-old girl, has recently returned to the place where she spent her childhood, Bucco. The arrival of the mysterious Saverio gradually upsets the harmony of the "holy" place, unearthing a crime committed by the villagers 40 years before.

programme.title: The Harvest
programme.desc: Thousands of foreign workers support today the most known Italian excellence: agri-food production. A docu-musical shows their daily exploitation.

programme.title: Life with Father
programme.desc: A financier from New York rules his numerous family, consisting of his wife and his four sons, with the meticulousness of a bookkeeper.

programme.title: Went the Day Well?
programme.desc: The quiet village of Bramley End is taken over by German troops posing as Royal Engineers. Their task is to disrupt England's radar network in preparation for a full scale German invasion. Once the villagers discover the true identity of the troops, they do whatever they can to thwart the Nazis plans.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: Terror by Night
programme.desc: Holmes and Watson board a passenger train bound from London to Edinburgh, to guard the Star of Rhodesia, an enormous diamond worth a fortune belonging to an elderly woman of wealth; but within the first hour of the trip, the woman's son is murdered and the diamond stolen and any of the passengers in their car could be the killer thief.

programme.title: Autumn Has Already Started
programme.desc: A single mother from the country raising a 6th grade boy comes to Tokyo, leaves the boy to live with his uncle's family, runs a struggling grocery store, and works a local inn. The boy befriends a girl, the daughter of the innkeeper.

programme.title: The Murder in the Museum
programme.desc: When a city councilman is murdered while investigating allegations of drug dealing going on a a somewhat disreputable sideshow, the daughter of the chief suspect teams up with a newspaper reporter to find the real killer.

programme.title: Arima
programme.desc: ARIMA It is the story of four women and a girl who- se existence is disrupted by the sudden arrival of two strangers. One of them is fleeing from the other, sneaking around town like an elusive being, a ghostly presence of uncertain existence. The other character --an injured man carrying a gun-- will disrupt the women's way of life in different ways. The whole plot takes place on the fine line between reality and imagination, between dreams and nightmares, fear and desire, within a story shrouded in mystery ARIMA is something you glimpse through the mist, something you can sense but still fail to see clearly. A dream, a memory, a desire.

programme.title: Sixty Glorious Years
programme.desc: Picking up where Victoria the Great (1937) left off, this sequel to the 1937 film has Anna Neagle return to the role of Queen Victoria in another colorful account of the revered British monarch's reign.

programme.title: Bela Lugosi Meets a Brooklyn Gorilla
programme.desc: Two goofy entertainers meet a mad scientist on a jungle island.

programme.title: Father
programme.desc: Mourning the death of her father, Giulia is contacted by him from the other dimension.

programme.title: The Tune of the Wind
programme.desc: An 8 year old Bolivian boy gets lost on the streets of La Paz, hundreds of kilometers from home. He survives many challenges before he sets out in an emotive journey to find his lost father.

programme.title: Jack London
programme.desc: Episodes in adventurous life of the American novelist.

programme.title: Love Laughs at Andy Hardy
programme.desc: Andy Hardy goes to college after serving in the war and finds his sweetheart is engaged to someone else.

programme.title: Our Hospitality
programme.desc: A man returns to his Appalachian homestead. On the trip, he falls for a young woman. The only problem is her family has vowed to kill every member of his family.

programme.title: The Mysterious Mr. Wong
programme.desc: Mr. Wong is a "harmless" Chinatown shopkeeper by day and relentless blood-thirsty pursuer of the Twelve Coins of Confucius by night. With possession of the coins, Mr. Wong will be supreme ruler of the Chinese province of Keelat, and his evil destiny will be fulfilled. A killing spree follows in dark and dangerous Chinatown as Wong gets control of 11 of the 12 coins. Reporter Jason Barton and his girl Peg are hot on his trail, but soon find themselves in serious trouble when they stumble onto Wong's headquarters.

programme.title: The Phantom of 42nd Street
programme.desc: A theatre critic (Dave O'Brien) teams up with a cop (Jack Mulhall) to investigate the murder of a Broadway actor.

programme.title: Doctor Blood's Coffin
programme.desc: Greta is a beautiful young woman abused by her brother Franz and left to die in childbirth by her illicit lover, the aristocrat Dr. von Ravensbrück. Bereft with grief, Franz reanimates his dead sister using a formula engraved on an ancient Incan medallion. Greta then returns as an undead avenging angel, reaping revenge on the Ravensbrück family and her manically possessive brother.

programme.title: Please Murder Me
programme.desc: A lawyer tries to exact justice on a woman he defended in court -- a woman whom he found out was guilty after getting her off.

programme.title: Corpse Vanishes
programme.desc: A scientist, aided by an old hag and her two sons, kills virginal brides, steals their bodies, and extracts gland fluid to keep his ancient wife alive and young.

programme.title: The Trial
programme.desc: Josef K wakes up in the morning and finds the police in his room. They tell him that he is on trial but nobody tells him what he is accused of. In order to find out about the reason for this accusation and to protest his innocence, he tries to look behind the façade of the judicial system. But since this remains fruitless, there seems to be no chance for him to escape from this nightmare.

programme.title: Pride of the West
programme.desc: Caldwell and Nixon have their men rob the stage and then critcize the Sheriff for not catching the robbers. With her father the Sheriff under pressure, Mary sends for Hoppy who finds the stolen money and sets a trap to bring in the entire gang.

programme.title: Bulldog Drummond's Bride
programme.desc: Hugh "Bulldog" Drummond is on the precipice of matrimony to his beloved Phyllis -- but a bank robbery and a daring escape is going to get in their way before they reach the altar.

programme.title: Road Gate
programme.desc: Rauan works at a parking lot in a prestigious residential area. Aidar passes him daily in his luxurious car. The auto belongs to his father, who works in the oil business. Rauan and Aidar are both determined to build their own lives themselves. They live in the same city, their paths cross in the same yard, but there is an abyss between them. They are separated by a toll-bar between wealth and poverty. One day Aidar and Rauan will clash and their worlds will clash. What will the results be..?

programme.title: Revenge of the Zombies
programme.desc: When Dr. Von Altermann's wife Lila dies mysteriously at his spooky mansion her relations suspect murder. They also suspect the doctor is turning her into a zombie, to join the army of living dead he hopes to devote to the Nazi cause. However, Lila, though dead, has developed a will of her own.

programme.title: The Hoodlum
programme.desc: Vincent Lubeck is a vicious ex-convict. His criminal activities are despised by his family, but he uses and abuses them in the course of his crimes. Eventually his own brother must stand up to him

programme.title: Behind Green Lights
programme.desc: An unscrupulous private investigator with a penchant for blackmail is found dead in a car and the leading suspect is Janet Bradley, the daughter of a mayoral candidate. With the election just weeks away, shady and ruthless individuals muscle the medical officer into switching the corpse with another body. Lieutenant Sam Carson, one of the few good apples in the bunch must find a way to get to the bottom of it all.

programme.title: The Last Time I Saw Paris
programme.desc: Love, marriage and heartache in paris after the war.

programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Newly appointed sheriff Pat Garrett is pleased when his old friend Doc Holliday arrives in Lincoln, New Mexico on the stage. Doc is trailing his stolen horse, and it is discovered in the possession of Billy the Kid. In a surprising turnaround, Billy and Doc become friends. This causes the friendship between Doc and Pat to cool. The odd relationship between Doc and Billy grows stranger when Doc hides Billy at his girl Rio's place after Billy is shot.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Masters of stealth or speed, using enhanced senses and lethal strategies to hunt, Africa's killers include the incredibly fast cheetah and lions, which while slower, have raw power and ingenious teamwork on their side. The rivers, meanwhile, hold fearsome crocodiles.

programme.title: Creative Killers
programme.desc: Across Africa, predators use the land to amplify their hunting skills. In Ndutu, cheetahs rely on speed and lookout points, even using fawns as bait. Lions, heavier and slower, depend on cover—gullies, marshes, forests—for ambushes. As the wildebeest migration arrives, we follow three characters through the rainy season, watching calves grow and predators adapt. The film explores how these hunters use the landscape, passing knowledge from one generation to the next.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: There's more than just one creature lurking in this black lagoon. Here, in this bizarre netherworld between river and ocean, evolution has created a variety of freakish assassins, many of whom can strike in the blink of an eye. Witness the fast-paced, deadly action up close and in slow motion as our high-speed cameras capture sharp-shooting archerfish, African fish eagles, mantis shrimp, and other killers at work. Cutting-edge CGI details show just how they use their alien jaws, spear-like arms, and color-changing skin as weapons of underwater war.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Believe it or not, many scuba divers want to see great whites up close, and photographers want dramatic shots. But how do you get the sharks to where you want them? For decades, it's been done by baiting, or "chumming" _ attracting sharks with food. This practice is being questioned and banned in many countries because of a dramatic increase in shark attacks.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Rafa, the 'Birdman of Loro Parque', proudly leads the Foundation's ornithological work, surrounded daily by parrots, puffins, and penguins. Meanwhile, Inaki faces a challenge: training Sue-Anne the anteater. Armed with vanilla yoghurt and patience, he's hoping charm wins over stubbornness. Will she cooperate or snub his efforts?

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: O Say can you see? We're in Baltimore, MD. We'll learn about the Battle of Baltimore at Fort McHenry and the inspiration of the Star Spangled Banner. Then we dig deep into the history of Baltimore's most famous resident, Edgar Allan Poe. We'll sift through a huge collection of pop art and collectibles at the Geppi Museum, and learn about cracking codes at the National Cryptology museum.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson. They go to a traditional waterhole and chat over a camp fire about Sammy's ancestral knowledge of the land. Ray spends the night out under the stars before driving more inland to rocky areas where water collects. There Ray comes face to face with a wild kangaroo and rock wallabies. He then follows tracks along a dry river bed that lead him to Australia's wild dog: a dingo.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: We explore the capital of India. The bustling metropolis is filled with modern skyscrapers that stand side-by-side with hundreds of ancient monuments, making Delhi a physical dichotomy of yesterday and tomorrow. In the old city, we travel by rickshaw through the narrow streets and discover a world that is quickly disappearing. Then it's on to the tomb of Humayun, whose architectural design inspired one of the Seven Wonders of the World, the great Taj Mahal. We visit 2 mosques that are in the record books: the very first mosque in Delhi and the largest mosque in India. Next we visit the National Gandhi Museum where we view personal items from Gandhi's life, visit a temple that's open to all faiths and complete the quickest tour of India, without leaving Delhi.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Two of the greatest ancient monuments in the world are in South India—Hampi and Konark. These two wonders of the world were lost to the west, but now are at the top of many bucket lists. Join Bill as he takes the veil off these two incredible achievements of man.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Featured in films and documentaries, the mane-less lions of Tsavo have a fierce reputation _ man-eaters. Journeys embarks on a photo hunt for these legendary beasts of the bush. In the process, we witness the raw power of the ghosts in the dark.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Once a year in good rain years, the deserts of South Africa explode in color. This is the greatest flower bloom in the world. We venture into the desert to experience this first-hand and film the rare animals that call this arid land home.

programme.title: Nomads

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.desc: The commercial space flight companies are edging closer and closer to flight readiness. Paying customers will soon be launching into space; tourists and their money is thought to be a major step forward into space and beyond. Blue Origin flight tests have been a great success and may launch commercial flights as soon as year's end. Virgin Galactic is also smashing mile stones towards flight certification. SpaceX and its Manned Dragon capsule in direct competition with Boeings moves closer to an ISS taxi service.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The ESA _ JAXA joint Bepi-Colombo Mission is moments away from launch. The target is Mercury which has been too long neglected; this mission will shed new light on this strange world of light and dark.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's one of the world's most famous train stations _ Grand Central Terminal. We'll take you on a trip to reveal its many fascinating secrets! And if they are cleaned without water, how do clothes get spotless when they are dry cleaned?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's cheesy and and eaten all over the world! You'll learn how Dominick's pizza became Domino's pizza. And we all know how going to a circus wouldn't be complete without fluffy sweet cotton candy! We'll explain how this feathery goodness Spun to life! And all the spy action heroes use them, but where did the term gadget really come from?

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.desc: In this episode of Desperate Hours, we slip the surly bonds of earth to encounter disasters in the air. There have been accidents in the air ever since the time of the Wright brothers and all the improvements in aviation technology since then have lessened but by no means eliminated the dangers of flying. We hope, however, that you are not frantically cancelling your next flight after watching this episode. The chance of getting into or anywhere near a plane crash is actually very low and the air travel is considered one of the safest forms of transport. Many more people die in automobile accidents every year, admittedly with the difference that they don't usually die hundreds at a time. With that sobering thought, we say farewell, and fly safely

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Loro Parque, voted "World's Best Zoo" two years in a row, blends top-tier animal care with global conservation efforts. From thousands of species to multi-million-dollar research, its mission is clear: protect wildlife and inspire change. What began 45 years ago as one man's passion is now a global model of excellence in education, sustainability, and animal welfare.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Federica the turtle has arrived from Italy after a run in with a container ship. Loro Parque's offered to be her 'forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? You've heard of a fish out of water _ try a turtle!Esmeralda the iguana has a lumpy belly and Jorge the vet is worried. He's hoping it's a bounty of eggs but knows he shouldn't count his iguanas before they hatch. Its fingers crossed for some scaly babies!

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: We live in a world full of the most magnificent of animals. There are approximately eight point seven (8.7) million different species on earth. With this vast array of natural wonders how do we choose a favorite amongst all these spectacular creatures? The ethereal grace of the oceans whales, the might of the imposing hippo, the unequalled speed of the cheetah, the mesmerizing lure of the snake, the power of the elephant, the strength of the ant, the stealth of the scorpion, the extraordinary talents of the octopus, the force of the crocodile, the sheer grace of the wedge tailed eagle, or the regular commanding presence of the lion...

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The mighty grizzly bear. The tiny powerful ant. The lunging inimitable crocodile. The indestructible rhino beetle. The hammering mantis shrimp. Which is the strongest of them all? Grizzly Bear _ North America's sub-alpine lands are ruled by its mightiest resident. Ants _ With 12,000+ species, ants are fierce, territorial defenders, dispatching intruders with ease. Crocodile _ Ancient rulers of rivers, crocodiles have the strongest bite force ever recorded. Rhino Beetle _ This forest dweller can lift 850 times its own weight. Mantis Shrimp _ With bizarre eyes and a punch as strong as a .22 bullet, it's a tiny powerhouse.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: There's no doubt sharks have an image problem. And they're certainly in trouble globally. The population of some species has declined by more than 90% due to over fishing. But there's still one place in the world where sharks thrive _ the Bahamas. Sharks not only prosper there, they are highly protected. It's illegal to kill them. Stuart Cove's passion is sharks. Travelling In his private plane, he spreads the gospel of shark advocacy across the Bahamian island chain. And shark tourism is his livelihood. A successful entrepreneur, his main business revolves around scuba diving with sharks. Cove also works with Bahamian and international researchers in their studies of dangerous species such as tiger, hammerhead and bull sharks.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Prey must constantly avoid predators, and any defensive adaptation boosts survival. Speed is a key defense—antelope are built to run, chased by sprinters like cheetahs. Over time, predators evolved to be fast, and prey evolved to be faster. Antelope also travel long distances for food. Ostriches, though flightless, are the fastest-running birds. The Golden Wheel spider escapes danger by turning into a rolling wheel. In the Race of Life, survival depends on clever, sometimes surprising adaptations.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Predator vs. prey: this episode explores three bird escape tactics—climbing flight, horizontal speed, and diving. These behaviors reflect the evolutionary arms race. Birds of prey captivate us, from the mighty eagle soaring over open spaces to the peregrine falcon, the fastest animal alive. Vultures, often seen as omens, strip carcasses clean to survive. Whether elegant hunters or grim scavengers, each raptor plays its part in the Race of Life, adapting to stay one step ahead.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan joins an expedition to recruit a new Blue World camera operator in the form of a 1,000 pound Tiger shark! Working with experienced shark handlers, he puts a camera on the dorsal fin of the shark to see what it can film all by itself. But will Jonathan get his camera back? Next, he joins an experienced cave diver to explore a famous underwater cave in Northern Florida (USA).

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Cave diving is the most difficult and dangerous type of diving, so the training to become a certified cave diver is arduous. This episode documents Jonathan's actual cave training in the Bahamas and follows him as he learns how to dive safely in the overhead environment of a cave in an attempt to earn his full cave diver certification.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Alexander Graham Bell, inspired by a misunderstood German paper, aimed to send multiple tones through a wire—leading to the invention of the telephone. He discovered that voice vibrations vary electric current strength, enabling sound transmission. Though revolutionary, it took time for people to grasp its impact. Today, wireless calls dominate, yet still rely on Bell's principles. As tech evolves, we may soon see phoneless communication.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Plastic, once accidental, is now essential—from machines to daily items. It began with explosive billiard balls and beetle poop, leading to Bakelite and later nylon. Nylon's popularity even sparked riots during WWII. But plastic's durability and oil-based origin raise environmental concerns. Now, bioplastics grown in microorganisms—and possibly plants—offer quirky, sustainable alternatives for the future.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's been sweetening America for almost 40 years! Now, find out the truth behind how Sweet N Low actually got its name! And why do we yell shotgun when getting into a car with friends? Then, is it really bad luck to open an umbrella in the house? And, learn the salty truth on how the potato chip was invented out of anger!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Learn the secrets behind thermos' amazing technology! And they were the sweet candy pellets we loved as a kid, but did you know that Pez was created to help people stop smoking? And find out how a steamboat inspired Samuel Langhorne Clemens to change his name to Mark Twain!

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Some of the proof of Einstein's theories had long been elusive, beyond the capabilities of technology, until now. It appears that Einstein is once again triumphant with the latest in deep space observations.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: We're looking hard, but the numbers aren't stacking up, is life on other planets that hard to find? Even signals from an advanced race elude us. Maybe we really are alone in our neck of the galaxy!

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: The Body Transfer Illusion tricks the brain into feeling ownership of a fake body part, like in the rubber hand experiment. The Autokinetic Effect makes stationary lights seem to move in darkness. The Moon Illusion causes the moon to appear larger near the horizon due to visual references. Geometric illusions distort shapes and lines through clever design. Stereoscopy lets us perceive depth by merging two flat images into one 3D view.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Animation creates motion from still images shown in rapid sequence. Aviation illusions affect pilots' balance due to conflicting sensory input. The spinning dancer illusion shows bistable perception—viewers may see it spin in either direction. Mirages occur when light bends through layers of air at different temperatures. Rainbows form when sunlight refracts and reflects through water droplets, splitting light into visible colors.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.
